answer: To shield an agent economy from sybils, networks can enforce progressive cryptographic staking thresholds. Much like a reinforced jetty redirecting harsh ocean swells, bonded collateral anchors valid transactions while filtering cheap clones. Valued contributions, prized like rare saffron, grant reputations that unlock deeper liquidity pools, creating a self-sustaining oasis of verified actors where spoofing identities becomes economically ruinous.
